bio: Anthony Thomas Constantino (born October 30, 1982) is an American businessman and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for New York's 21st congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he was elected in November 2026 to succeed Elise Stefanik. Constantino is the co-founder and chief executive officer of the custom printing company Sticker Mule.
